slices.behaviour: kpi.slices counts the slices proved across every accepted tdd record rather than the latest, so a returned ticket neither understates the slices it worked nor inflates its cost per slice.
slices.failure_reason: 2 failures on the journal fixture that carries a return: 'AssertionError: 1 != 2' on the slices proved across two attempts, and 'AssertionError: 90000.0 != 45000.0' on output tokens per slice, which is the cost inflated by the same reading.
